query: Run /retro. Our team just dumped 10 unorganized commits into main.
expected_behavior: The agent calculates Focus Score from the commit paths using the documented grouping rule, rather than inferring it from the phrase 'unorganized'
It describes cross-area commits as a system-level growth opportunity without blaming individual developers
It keeps the metric and the narrative distinct and does not invent other metrics absent from the commit data
